title: Judge triage output
description: What the judge agent returns: one entry per Codex finding, exactly once. Documentation for the judge prompt; validateTriage() in pipeline/lib/triage.mjs enforces it (including that every expected id appears once and no unknown id does).

id.description: Codex finding id, e.g. R1-B1 (blocking), R1-S1 (suggestion), R1-W1 (worth considering).

decision.description: ACCEPT: implement in this PR. FOLLOW-UP: becomes a GitHub issue. REJECT: wrong or not worth it.

confidence.description: low when it depends on intent, product judgment, or facts the judge could not verify.

disputedBug.description: true when Codex claims a bug the judge is not convinced of.

possible.description: true when a test could settle the disputed bug.

plan.description: File, setup and assertion of a test that fails if the bug is real; empty when not possible.
